correctness.rationale: For a unit direction u, Minkowski support additivity gives X_d(u)=0.5 E|T_d(u)+sum_i epsilon_i u_i|, including the zero Boolean vector harmlessly. A shift-uniform Gaussian smoothing/Lindeberg replacement controls the difference from F(T_d(u)) by C(sum_i |u_i|^3)^(1/3); for Haar u the maximum coordinate vanishes in probability and T_d(u) tends to a standard normal. Spherical even-moment bounds and X_d<=0.5(|T_d|+1) yield every fixed positive moment. The correlated bivariate normal absolute-product identity gives EF(Z)=1/sqrt(pi) and Var(F(Z))=1/12+(sqrt(3)-2)/(2*pi)>0. The exact finite mean E sqrt(K)*Gamma(d/2)/(sqrt(pi) Gamma((d+1)/2)) with K~Bin(d,1/2) and asymptotics give (1+1/(8d)+O(d^-2))/sqrt(pi). Independently compared direct generator-sum widths in 38 finite cases and exact binomial/gamma corrections through d=256. These tests are corroboration of the analytic infinite-d result, not a replacement.
